name: Davco® Ceramaflex
tagline: A FLEXIBLE, THIN OR THICK BED, OFF WHITE, RUBBER MODIFIED CEMENT-BASED TILE ADHESIVE
summary: Davco® Ceramaflex is a flexible, thin or thick bed, off white, rubber modified cement-based tile adhesive. Davco® Ceramaflex is designed for wall & floor applications for both internal and external applications.
metaDescription: Davco® Ceramaflex is a flexible, thin or thick bed, off white, rubber modified cement-based tile adhesive. Davco® Ceramaflex is designed for wall & floor applications for both internal and external applications.
usage: Davco® Ceramaflex is suitable for thin or thickbed applications both internally and externally.
Timber floor (with fibre cement sheet underlay)

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
Store in dry cool conditions above ground out of direct sunlight.
High humidity will reduce shelf life.

items.label: Mixing Ratio
items.text: 7-8 Litres clean potable water per 20kg bag.

items.label: Layer Thickness
items.text: Maximum layer shall be no greater than 10mm.

items.label: Applied Product Ready for Use
items.text:
Set time before to grouting | 24 hours
Set time before dry area service | 24 hours
Set time before wet area service | 7 days
All measurements are taken at 22°C and 50% Relative Humidity. Specifications vary according to site conditions and should be taken as a guide only.

items.label: Consumption
items.text: A 20kg bags cover approximately 14m2 with a 6mm notch trowel.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Select a trowel with a suitable notch size for the tile size and type as per the following;
Tile Size | Trowel notch size | Back Buttering required
Mosaic's | 4-6mm
150x150 | 6mm
200x200 300x300 400x400 and over *Tiles with lugs or uneven backs Translucent tiles | 8mm 10mm 12mm *as above dependent on size *as above | Yes Yes Yes

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Measure the required amount of clean potable water into a bucket (8 Litres per bag).
Slowly add the powder into the water while mixing with a mixing paddle attached to a drill (Max 500 RPM). Do not mix by hand.
Continue to mix for 2-3 minutes until a smooth, limp free creamy mixture is achieved.
Allow the mixture to stand for 5 minutes then restir for an additional minute.
*Adhesive may need restirring during the potlife, do not add more water.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Laying the Tiles
Place the adhesive onto the prepared and primed substrate. Do not apply more adhesive than can be tiles within the open time of the product, usually from a single tile to 1m2.
Hold the notched trowel at an angle of 60° or greater to the substrate.
Spread the adhesive over the required area where tile is to be applied, comb the adhesive in a single direction (not swirls).
Where "back buttering" the tile is required, use the flat side of the notched trowel to apply a thin adhesive layer to the back of the tile (approx 1-2mm thick).
Place the tile into the combed adhesive and press the tile firmly.
Move the tile forward and then back at 90° across the direction of the combed adhesive to flatten the adhesive to leave no voids under the tile. Occassionally life a tile to check the adhesive covers 90-100% of the tile.
Remove any excess adhesive in the joints, and on the face of the tile with a sponge and water while the adhesive is still wet.
Do not allow the adhesive to skin prior to placement of the tiles. If the adhesive skins, remove and replace.
Application shall be in accordance with AS3958.1
Movement joints shall be installed in accordance with applicable standards.
Back buttering the tiles may be required to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
Allow the adhesive to dry prior to grouting.

items.label: CLEANING OF TOOLS
items.text: Clean tools and equipment with water orior to adhesive drying.
